prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: parking lot collision. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1282; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was stopped and waiting for a parking space when your insured's vehicle backed into the driver's side of our client's car. The impact was significant enough to deploy the airbag warning system and leave both vehicles with visible structural damage, and the police report prepared at the scene reflects that your insured acknowledged the contact.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a lumbar back strain. Within hours, our client experienced stiffness, muscle spasms, and pain that radiated into the hip. Medical providers have prescribed physical therapy, prescription anti-inflammatory medication, and a period of restricted activity. Our client has missed time from work and continues to struggle with ordinary tasks such as lifting, driving for extended periods, and sleeping through the night.

Liability is clear. Your insured was operating the vehicle in reverse and failed to keep a proper lookout before moving. We have enclosed the medical records, billing statements, wage documentation, photographs of the damage, and the police report.

Our client is prepared to resolve this matter without litigation. We demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response by that deadline, we will file suit without further notice.
